question: What claim about the range of languages arises from the distinction between those heard and those not yet heard in this context?
premises: Languages of varied forms are present as a class.
Some of those forms fall into the category of heard sounds.
Some of those forms fall into the category of unheard sounds.
inference: The field of languages includes both heard and unheard forms of varied kinds.
uncertainties: It is unclear whether the distinction is ontological or experiential.
plain_english: Indeed, languages of varied forms arise, both heard and unheard.
